extraction_metadata.extraction_notes: Image-only PDF (each page a single 150-ppi raster, no text layer, no vector rules). Rule lines recovered from the raster (vertical rules by column ink fraction, horizontal rules by row ink fraction > 85%); marks detected by near-black pixel counts (<90) per cell (empty cells 0, marks 28-56) and validated against visual reads of every row. All text visually transcribed. Header rows reprinted on pages 10-12 de-duplicated. One label column (L=1); data columns 2-35 = V1..V34. Trial NN9536-4378.

table_metadata.table_purpose: Main schedule of activities: screening, randomisation, dose escalation, maintenance, end of treatment and end of trial
table_metadata.notes: Single printed table ("2 Flowchart") running over document pages 9-12 under a reprinted header; one table, not continuations. Page 11 and 12 each open with one activity row printed above the reprinted Visit/Timing/Window rows.

schedule_properties.property_comment: Top header band (label cell empty): study periods Screening (V1), Randomisation (V2), Dose escalation period (P3-V10, merged), Maintenance period (P11-V32, merged), End of treatment (V33), End of trial (V34). Typed epoch because the values name study phases; name synthesised. Merge extents taken from raster vertical-rule gaps.
Visit identifiers V1-V34; prefix V = site visit, P = phone contact (per the row label). Unique per column, so typed visit.
Planned visit timing in weeks relative to randomisation (-1 to 111). Label printed "Timing of visit (Weeks)" (lower-case v) on the page-12 reprint. Typed week.

Allowed visit window in days (-7 to 0, 0, ±3, 0 to +5). Typed window; hierarchical_level null because it does not distinguish any column from another. V33 prints ±3 on pages 9-10 but ±5 on the page 11-12 reprints; ±3 (first print) recorded, see review item D1.

annotations.annotation_text: Reviewer note, not source content: the End of treatment (V33) visit window is printed as ±3 on pages 9-10 and as ±5 on the reprinted header of pages 11-12; ±3 (first printed) is recorded. The source is inconsistent and the protocol text available does not resolve it.

review_items.call_made: The V33 (End of treatment) visit window is recorded as ±3 days, as printed on pages 9 and 10.
review_items.alternative: Record ±5 days, as printed on the reprinted header of pages 11 and 12.

review_items.call_made: Two rows printed between the period band and the reprinted Visit header (page 11 "Breast neoplasms follow-up", page 12 "Training in trial product, pen-handling") are treated as ordinary activity rows in reading order: Breast neoplasms follow-up under SAFETY, Training under REMINDERS.
review_items.alternative: Treat them as belonging to a different section (e.g. the Training row as TRIAL MATERIAL) or re-order them after the reprinted header rows.

review_items.call_made: Control of Eating Questionnaire marks are transcribed as lower-case "x" exactly as printed (smaller glyph than every other mark).
review_items.alternative: Normalise them to "X" as a typesetting inconsistency with the same meaning.

review_items.call_made: The unlabelled top band is typed epoch for all six values, including the single-column "Randomisation" (V2), "End of treatment" (V33) and "End of trial" (V34) cells.
review_items.alternative: Type the single-column cells as visit-level labels and keep only Screening / Dose escalation / Maintenance as epochs.
